briefdescription.para: Wrap a shared_ptr<Bytes> to create an owning segment.
Create a non-owning segment that references external memory.

detaileddescription.para: The caller must guarantee that data remains valid for the lifetime of this segment.

briefdescription.para: This class represents a piece of memory.

detaileddescription.para:
Supports two modes:
Owning mode: holds a shared_ptr<Bytes> for lifetime management.
Non-owning (view) mode: holds a raw pointer to external data. The caller must ensure the underlying memory outlives this segment.
